tier1.text: Each opponens pollicis moves the thumb across the palm toward the other fingers. This movement, called opposition, brings the tip of the thumb to the tip of a finger. Thumb movements like this play a key part in most precise movements of the hand. The opponens pollicis is a thenar muscle, part of the fleshy mound at the base of the thumb.

quotes.quote: The thenar muscles include the abductor pollicis brevis, opponens pollicis, flexor pollicis brevis, and the adductor pollicis. These muscles form the thenar eminence, the rounded contour of the base of the thumb, and all act on the thumb.
